name: D - Order Notifications and Status Dispatcher

parameters.query: SELECT CASE WHEN $3::text <> '' THEN bakery.fn_set_payment_status($1::text, $3::text, $4::text, $5::text) ELSE bakery.fn_set_order_status($1::text, $2::text, $4::text, $5::text) END AS r

parameters.content:
**Workflow D: outbox dispatcher + staff status API**
Sends every queued WhatsApp message (customer replies, order confirmations, bakery alerts). Orders are already committed before anything is sent.
Staff API: POST /webhook/bakery-order-status  header per credential 'Bakery Staff Webhook Key'
body {"order_ref":"BK-...","status":"PREPARING"} or {"order_ref":"BK-...","payment_status":"PAID","actor":"name"}
Requires n8n env: META_PHONE_NUMBER_ID, WHATSAPP_API_VERSION (e.g. v21.0 - check Meta docs for a currently supported version).
Credentials: 'Bakery Postgres', 'WhatsApp Cloud Bearer' (Header Auth: Authorization = Bearer <token>), 'Bakery Staff Webhook Key'.
